title: Hybrid retrieval
summary: Select search and retrieval methods according to the question and available evidence.

sections.label: Retrieval routes
items: Exact search for identifiers, symbols, filenames and precise terms.
Semantic search where conceptual matching adds useful evidence.
Structured queries where the data supports them. SPARQL applies to RDF relationships.
Filter by access and relevant versions. Include jurisdiction, effective period or approval state when the question depends on them.

sections.label: Proposed sequence
sections.text: Retrieve a bounded candidate set, verify relevance/applicability, and provide source passages with identifiers. Add reranking only if it measurably helps.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: The needed evidence is retrieved, permitted, current for the question, and accessible for verification. Measure retrieval separately from answer generation.

catalog.applicability: Use this when choosing how to retrieve evidence for a question by combining exact search, semantic search, structured queries such as SPARQL over RDF, and access or version filters. Retrieve a bounded candidate set, verify relevance and applicability, and measure retrieval separately from answer generation.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
